content: Yach Mel Bo Gich Kristiano

Kristus ila iy semal yarmat ngo ye hafohoy woal krud. Ila hami be wol ila sengal kelel yami luluwal le yebe wochog iy; bo fael mala te tugul semal le be hafohoy ngo yebe chuy mo luwul mala kelel molfid.
Ila igla sa loh le habe mel le habe dabey chog mala depel Deus, ngo ha towe dabey meka deper yarmat.
Ha ligdi wegdeg kala hama faesul foforadoh muswe le wegdegel maltemay, mo habbelas, mo hasorol todeb.
Iwe ngo igla le hami ha tay dabey wegdeg kala yar rechokla rete chepar irel Deus le wegdegel moniyan, ngo ir resa luwdah iyang. Iwe ngo re hapatpat tayikof iremi.
Ir rebe taldi kofer ngal Deus le ye faesul fel le iy mele yebe hatugulu kofer cho molow mo cho mes.

Ila fal le re wol foloyu Hapatpat Momay le ngalir cho mes, le rechokla Deus ye hatugulu kofer le pangal yarmat ngo yebe hatugulu kofer. Ye foloyu ngalir Hapatpat Momay le bo hare rebe molow irel molow la yael Deus le ila mele iy ye dipli bo rebe mel iyang.
Yach Be Yengang Fengal
Mala haigugul loh pangal faormel ila yesa harep. Ha mel le yebe pos yami mel ngo ha faesul hafelfel bo yebe yoh le habe ma mepel.
Ngo luwul pangal meka ngo habe hachangi semal mo semal hami, bo hachangcheng ila ye totawo loh pangal molfid.
Ha sugu yimmi ngal semal mo semal le yebe fel wey mo lal dipmi.
Semal gich ngo Deus ye fang ngali semat kefang bo yebe tapeli bo yebe mmal yarmat iyang.

Semal le yebe foloy, ngo yebe foloyu mala yalol Deus; iwe ngo semal le yebe yengang ngal eklesia, ngo yebe tapeli pangal mekla kelal le Deus ye fang ngali. Ila ngo pangal formel le yarmat rebe foru, ngo rebe hapingpinga Deus irel Jesus Kristus le iy mele ye lamli falmay ngo yor kkamlal le tor siyal. Amen.
Yach Gich Kristiano Hafohoy
Rewol maryarey, ha towe lluwdah irel hafohoy ka hasa mel luwulul, bo ika mele yebe kawraloh le yesa tugul lal dipmi. Iwe ngo ha towe sor le sew formel le moch wel ngalugmi.
Yebe far momay lal dipmi irel mala hasa dabey Kristus irel hafohoy kala yal, bo yebe kel yami rraey irel yodla bela lahloh falmay la yal.
Iwe ngo yebe wol rraey lal dipmi le yarmat rebe hapatpat tayikof iremi irel mala hami re dabeyel Kristus; bo Espritu Santus ila ye mel iremi.
Hare semal hami yesa hafohoy ila ngo ye hafohoy le te fal mala yesa limeseloh semal, hare ye pera lital semal, hare ye hapilsedaw ngal yael semal yengang.
Iwe ngo hare re hafohoyugmi le fael mala hami Kristiano ngo tor mele habe maa iyang, bo habe kangalu Deus yal hachigchig irel yami la mel bo hami Kristiano.

Mala yodol Tatelal Hapatpat ila yesa harep, iwe ngo Deus yebe moal hatugulu kofer mekla lol. Iwe ngo hare gich mele Deus yebe moal hatugulu kofach, ila ngo be ifa lepal tayikofel hagerger la yebe holar rechokla rete chepar irel Hapatpat Momay we be budoh mo irel Deus?
Bo babior we ye santus ye sor bo,

content.text: “Ye weres le rechokla re momay rebe daor;
ila ngo meda kofer choto hamolfid!”

content: Rechokla re hafohoy ila Deus mele ye dipli bo be ila senger bo rebe taboloh chog yar foru mekla ye momay. Iwe ngo rebe yetedah chog yar luglug woal yeramtala iy mele ye foru pangal formel, iwe ngo yema foru mekla iy ye hatugulu.
